Nina K.: quick report - ran into weird race where auth refresh + fast reconnect causes duplicated final token + out-of-order tiny-deltas in sampleapp. seems SDK parity + parser state both involved.
Omar: ouch. which sdks + sampleapp?
Nina K.: mobile sampleapp (android polyfill) talking to python backend via envoy. flow: 1) stream emits multi-line final event split over frames 2) client token expires mid-stream -> client does auth refresh on reconnect 3) reconnect sends Last-Event-ID but sometimes envoy lowercases to last-event-id and resume logic misses it -> server replays buffer. also observed that if parser had partially buffered a split event we sometimes double-flush that partial on EOF.
Omar: can you paste the raw capture?
Nina K.: pasted minimal capture: 
```
event: message
data: {"id":"sess-900","part":1,"chunk":"abc"

# network drop ~120ms, client refreshes auth
> GET /v1/stream HTTP/1.1
> Host: staging.api
> Authorization: Bearer ey...refreshed
> last-event-id: sess-900

# downstream router access log shows header as "last-event-id: sess-900"
# server resume check reads r.Header.Get("Last-Event-Id") -> empty -> replay buffer -> we get duplicated sess-900
```
Celeste: two failure modes here: header-casing + parser flush. Envoy will lowercase; Go net/http canonicalizes but only after request reaches service. If an envoy filter reconstructs headers, weirdness can happen. Also if parser treats EOF during partial event as complete it will enqueue partial. When resume happens we replay that same partial.
Arjun: short fixes: 1) router middleware that normalizes any-case resume header into canonical "Last-Event-Id", 2) server-side dedupe by event id when applying resumed events, 3) unit test simulating mid-chunk EOF + reconnect.
Arjun: SDK parity fix: make all sdks send both headers (Last-Event-ID and last-event-id) on reconnect for extra safety and add a tiny jittered backoff before reconnecting if auth refresh happens immediately. That reduces races for mobile polyfills.
Nina K.: I'll open two PRs: sampleapp (adds canonical header + jitter backoff) and platform/router (middleware + unit test). also add an e2e that splits final token across two TCP writes then forces an auth-refresh+reconnect to catch both dup and missing cases.
mobile-bot: note - some EventSource polyfills (android-webview) always set last-event-id lowercase. doc: https://internal.docs/eventsource-polyfills
ci-bot: triggered build #8230 for sampleapp/pr-251.
Omar: one more gotcha - if auth header changes we currently treat it as new session and skip resume dedupe. middleware should preserve resume token lookup across auth changes.
Celeste: yes - dedupe should be based solely on event-id, independent of auth headers. idempotency key at apply stage.
Nina K.: agreed. i'll include a small migration note in the SDK changelog and sampleapp onboarding docs so integrators know to update polyfills.
Arjun: thanks. follow-ups: add flaky-marker to e2e that tests this (we expect network jitter to be flaky), and add a short bullet in devex FAQ about header casing + auth-refresh interplay. :mag:
